name: Biology

requirements.label: One biology course with C or higher
requirements.note: Grade of C or higher required. Incoming 3rd-year transfers may declare while enrolled in one 3000-level BIOL course (preferably a core course).

declaration.notes: Declare after earning C or better in BIOL 2100, BIOL 2200 or any 2000+ BIOL course. Third-year transfers may declare only the B.A. initially.

requirements.label: Introductory biology (science foundation)
requirements.note: AP Biology 5 or IB HL 6 gives credit for both.

requirements.label: Introductory chemistry with labs (science foundation)
requirements.note: Checklist: CHEM 1810/1811 may substitute; CHEM 1811 can cover both labs. Exact substitution combos beyond these are by department approval.

requirements.label: Additional math/statistics (science foundation)
requirements.note: MATH 1191 + MATH 1192 together also satisfy this slot.

requirements.label: Physics with workshops (science foundation)
requirements.note: Workshops must be taken in person; some AP Physics credit may satisfy lecture portions.

requirements.label: Biology core
requirements.note: Must be taken at UVA (post-matriculation transfer not allowed).

requirements.label: Electives (15 credits total, including lab)
requirements.note: Each elective must be 3+ credits; core courses and independent research/study do not count as the three elective courses (research may only satisfy the lab requirement via two semesters of BIOL 4910/4920). Only the EVSC/CHEM courses listed on the Biology 'courses offered' page count; max 6 credits from outside Biology.

children.label: Upper-level lab
children.note: Alternatives: any 3000+ course taught at Mountain Lake Biological Station, or two semesters of BIOL 4910/4920 research with the same mentor. Lab list from 2026-27 checklist (2025-26 list also had BIOL 4040, 4430).

notes: Upper-level major (core + lab + electives) is minimum 24 credits with major GPA >= 2.000. Max 6 credits from outside Biology department; max 6 credits independent research/study (BIOL 3900, 4900, 4910, 4920, 4930); BIOL 3910/3920 never count. CHEM 4440 may substitute for BIOL 3030 (not both). CHEM 4410 no longer counts from 2026-27. BIOL 3410/3420 count. Biology majors may not double major with Interdisciplinary Neuroscience BA or Cognitive Science BA (Neuroscience concentration). Double majors may share max 2 courses (3 with interdisciplinary majors). Official Record page (catoid=72&poid=11688) could not be read (rate limited/empty); encoded from department page and 2026-27 checklist. Course prerequisites taken from theCourseForum (SIS-derived); BIOL 3000 requires CHEM 1410+1420 or CHEM 1810+1820 (encoded slotwise).

requirements.note: Two semesters of research in the same lab (BIOL 4910/4920 then BIOL 4940 in spring) plus BIOL 4840 (fall, 1 cr). Department web page phrases it as two semesters of independent research plus BIOL 4840.
